name: Promarine Collagen Tripeptides
headline: Promarine Collagen Tripeptides
description: A modern, high-tech form of collagen for easier absorption, enriched with a complex of plant extracts, vitamins and hyaluronic acid for smooth, radiant skin and strong hair and nails.
howToUse: Adults – 1 bottle (50 ml) a day with food. Course: 10-30 days, repeated if needed.

manufacturing.expiration: 2 years from the date of manufacture
manufacturing.storage: Store in a dry place, protected from direct sunlight, out of reach of children, at a temperature not above +25°C.
manufacturing.ingredients: MaxiCollagen liquid hydrolysed fish collagen with tripeptides, hibiscus flower extract, white currant fruit extract, vitamin C (L-ascorbic acid), hyaluronic acid, vitamin B6 (pyridoxine hydrochloride), vitamin B2 (riboflavin), spinach leaf, biotin, excipients.
